dogecoin.text: Whatever elon musk says at SNL today will be instrumental to #dogecoin trajectory. Not even about his presence, it's his statements

Elon musk called the #doge a hustle. Made another condescending statement about it. As a result, #dogecoin dipped through the weekend 
Note that he made other impressive statements about doge but the few negative ones had major impact and dealt heavy blows
